parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Set Defaults').first().json.model, max_tokens: 4096, temperature: $('Set Defaults').first().json.temperature, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $('Sanitize Prompt').first().json.prompt_system }, { role: 'user', content: $('Sanitize Prompt').first().json.prompt_user }] }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO activity_log (project_id, agent_name, action, status, input_summary)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = NULLIF($1,'')::uuid),
  $2,
  'prompt_injection_attempt',
  'warning',
  $3
WHERE $4::boolean = true;
